verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the platform supports 100+ models spanning text, vision, audio, image and embeddings. They also list Vision Models for analyzing images and documents, so these non-chat modalities are offered on the same platform. The evidence is only index-level mentions on the introduction page. missing for 10: dedicated docs or API details for audio (speech-to-text/TTS) endpoints, image-generation API usage docs, a vision request example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
